title: Music
intro: Hello & welcome to my (very short) music page!
lead: I do music sometimes. It roughly went like this:
steps: I've played the piano since the age of 4 but the last time I went to a piano lesson was 10+ years ago
nonetheless I still love playing the piano so now I improvise piano covers of pop songs
I kinda want to sing them too so I now also arrange for a cappella
I realize that my vocal range isn't wide so I gotta write songs that I can sing
you know what, I might as well get into music production because my videos could use a bit of original music
??? IDK where this is headed yet, we will see...
outro: Anyways, I'd be so grateful if you followed my Spotify here :)
